site.name: MboteData
site.tagline: Kokanisa mpe kosomba ba forfait ya eSIM na Kongo — futa na Bitcoin Lightning to na mobile money.

home.heroSubtitle: Tala mpe kokanisa ba forfait ya eSIM ya ba réseaux ya solo, na nsima futa ndenge olingi — na portefeuille Lightning to na mbongo ya mobile money.
home.step1Body: Tala ba forfait ya eSIM ya Kongo na ntalo, données, mpe ntango ekowumela.
home.step2Body: Futa na portefeuille Bitcoin Lightning, to na M-Pesa / mobile money na nzela ya Machankura — carte bancaire te.
home.step3Body: Code QR ya eSIM na yo ekoya na ba instructions nsima ya kondimama ya paiement.

plans.title: Ba forfait ya eSIM ya Kongo
plans.subtitle: Ba forfait nyonso esalaka na réseau ya Vodacom, Orange, to Airtel na Kongo.
plans.empty: Forfait moko te ekokani na oyo oponi sik'oyo.

checkout.title: Sukisa paiement na yo
checkout.scanQr: Tanga code QR oyo na portefeuille Lightning na yo
checkout.machankuraTitle: Futa na mbongo ya mobile money na yo
checkout.machankuraBody: Portefeuille Bitcoin esengeli te — Machankura epesaka nzela ya kofuta facture Lightning oyo mbala moko na mbongo ya M-Pesa to mobile money na yo, na nzela ya USSD.
checkout.paymentConfirmed: Paiement endimami! eSIM na yo ezali koya.
checkout.paymentFailed: Facture oyo esili to endimami te. Bandela lisusu.
checkout.deliveryNote: Tokotindela yo code QR ya eSIM mpe ba instructions na contact oyo opesaki.
checkout.contactLabel: Email to numéro ya téléphone mpo na kotinda
